question: Padma Shri awardee Pratibha Prahlad is an exponent of which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prathibha Prahlad is a **renowned exponent of the classical Indian dance form Bharatanatyam**
 
• Prathibha Prahlad **is also an educator, choreographer, arts administrator, and author**.
 
• She** was the founding director of the Delhi International Arts Festival. **
 
• **Prathibha Prahlad's dance career has taken her to prestigious platforms around the world. **
 
• She has also created a dance production called Warrior Women of Bharat that portrays the courage and love for the motherland of women warriors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bharatanatyam originates from Tamil Nadu and is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork.
 
• Kathak comes from North India and is characterized by its intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures.
 
• Kathakali is a dance-drama from Kerala known for its elaborate costumes and detailed gestures.
 
• Manipuri is from Manipur, focusing on graceful and fluid movements.
 
• Kuchipudi from Andhra Pradesh combines fast rhythms with fluid movements.
 
• Odissi is from Odisha, known for its tribhanga posture and sculpturesque poses.
 
• Sattriya from Assam is a dance-drama performance art with roots in the Vaishnavism monasteries.
 
• Mohiniyattam from Kerala is characterized by gentle, swaying movements and feminine grace.
